mission.title: Useful Idiot
mission.description: Pick up a Redpill for a friendly interrogation.

phase.briefing: This is an important job, so listen carefully. The Merovingian wants you to get a certain Redpill out of a local Machine base. Messier knows things that will be very useful to us in the foreseeable future. The Merovingian is not going to be concerned if you kill all the Machine programs that you find there.

objective.text: Lead Messier out of the area

phase.briefing: You're out. Now get him to the next address. That is where you will find Clotilde.

enter.say: Clotilde is waiting for you. Leave Messier with her.
